messages:
Nate (AE): Morning folks, excited to start! I don't have HubSpot edit rights, Gong access, or the enterprise pricing grid. Also unsure who approves legal copy for outbound emails. Can someone point me to the right people/links? Thanks.

onboarding-bot: Welcome Nate (AE) to #sales! Buddy assigned: Priya (Enablement). You've been added to the "AE - Enterprise" Slack cohort. Check your email for invites.

Mae (Sales Ops): Welcome Nate! HubSpot invite sent to nate@redwood.ai and gave you "Sales Rep" permissions. If anything is missing let me know. Pricing grid (internal) is in Drive > Sales > Pricing, quick link: https://redwood.link/pricing-grid-enterprise. For legal-approved email snippets ping legal-ops@redwood.com or copy @Mae here and I'll route.

Nate (AE): HubSpot shows me but I can't edit existing deals, only create new ones.

Raj (IT): @Nate I set your role to "Deal Editor" now and re-synced. If you still see readonly try clearing cookies or use incognito. If you get a 403 error paste it here.

Nate (AE): No 403, edits work now. Thanks Raj.

Priya (Enablement): Nate  Gong invite on the way. For call scripts use "AE - Enterprise Script v4" in Confluence (link added to your onboarding bundle). We'll book a 30-min shadow with a top AE tomorrow at 10am PT. Also, legal-approved outbound snippets: https://redwood.link/legal-email-snippets (templates and required disclaimer language). If you want custom copy, Legal usually responds within 48h.

Gong-bot: Gong: user invite accepted for nate@redwood.ai. Recording upload enabled.

Nate (AE): Got Gong, can record. Quick question: where do we store objection handling one-pagers and battle cards?

Mae (Sales Ops): Battle cards live in Drive > Sales > Battlecards. I dropped "Cloud Migration" and "Compliance" cards into your bundle. If you'd like a printed wallet card DM me quantity and office.

Priya (Enablement): Also FYI: please add the "Enterprise - Pricing" checkbox to deals to trigger the proper quote flow. We use Qatalog for quoting; queue for sales ops reviews if >$250k ARR.

Nate (AE): Perfect. One last: who owns the refund/credits policy so I can answer finance questions on calls?

Mae (Sales Ops): Finance policy owned by @FinanceOps; quick excerpt is in the pricing grid doc. For anything borderline copy me and I'll loop them in.

Nate (AE): All good. Appreciate the speedy onboarding. See you on the shadow tomorrow. :party_parrot:

Priya (Enablement): Welcome aboard!
